# at3_standalone

ATRAC3 / ATRAC3plus decoders from FFmpeg (libavcodec), as extracted to be
standalone by the PPSSPP project (`ext/at3_standalone`).

Licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License, version 2.1 or later
(see the headers of each source file). `shim/` contains small replacements
for the PPSSPP headers the extraction referenced; it is part of this project.
